    The length function on representations #

    For a finite category J (such as the linear order Fin n, whose functors to FGModuleCat k are the representations of the linearly oriented quiver of type A) and a field k, the total dimension ∑ j, dim X(j) is a length function on J ⥤ FGModuleCat k.
